name: Seaforge: Shores of Atlantis
storyline:
Seaforge: Shores of Atlantis is a co-op survival crafting adventure set on a mysterious island archipelago. Players can explore alone or with friends as they gather resources, craft tools and equipment, build seaside bases, and create a new life among sunlit islands and long-lost ruins.

You arrive shipwrecked on a strange island. Beneath the waves, a vast underwater world offers rare materials, hidden treasures, glowing caves, and traces of Atlantis waiting to be uncovered. Every dive demands preparation: oxygen is limited, and the most valuable discoveries often lie far from the safety of home.

Above the surface, players can construct homes to shelter from the dangerous night, gardens to grow strange plants to make food and powerful potions, and crafting stations to prepare for expeditions into increasingly hostile territory. Strange insect-like creatures have emerged from the underworld, turning exploration into a constant balance between discovery and survival.

Combining the satisfaction of building a cozy home with the thrill of deep-sea exploration, Seaforge invites players to embark on their own adventure through Atlantis.
summary: Beneath the waves, the world of Atlantis awaits. Build your home base on sunlit Mediterranean shores, then dive into sunken ruins to uncover secrets of the deep. Get stronger, dive deeper, and battle dark forces with up to 3 friends in this underwater survival crafting odyssey!
